task: Given a support conversation (the customer's message), retrieve the Northwind policy passages a QA reviewer would need to judge whether the agent handled it correctly.
relevance_definition: A passage is RELEVANT if it states the policy that governs the customer's request (the rule, step, timeframe, fee or data-handling constraint an auditor would check the agent against). Mark a passage relevant even if its wording differs from the customer's. Passages about a neighbouring topic that an auditor would not cite are NOT relevant.
labelling_status: REVIEWED - all rows hand-reviewed against LABELLING.md (strict auditor-would-cite test). conv-0038 has no relevant passage (KB gap) and is excluded from scoring.
